title: Bravas Grilled Portobello Mushroom
description: A vegetarian twist on a Spanish classic, featuring smoky portobello mushrooms in a spicy bravas sauce.
instructions: Clean mushrooms and brush with oil.
Grill mushrooms for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender.
Meanwhile, sauté chopped lpeppery and lonion in a pan with a little oil until softened.
Stir in bravas sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Serve mushrooms with bravas sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
